description: Get the public Bezal profile for one business by UUID. Every business includes name, category, city, state, rating, review count, tier and quote_request_url (its public Bezal profile, where a person can send a request). Phone, website, address, hours, photos and coordinates are included only for providers on a paid Bezal plan, and the description only for providers on a higher paid plan. For services, use get_service_catalog.

id.description: The UUID of the business to look up

name: get_business
title: Get a business profile
